== Notes ==
* A total of 17 [[Antique Summoning Stone]]s can be gained per week.
* It takes 20 weeks to buy the required amount for [[Gift of Jade Mastery]] or 6 weeks by also completing daily [[The Battle for the Jade Sea|Dragon's End meta event]] and weekly [[Strike Mission|Strike missions]] with challenge mode active, unless they are bought from the [[Trading Post|trading post]]. 
* Added with the ''[[Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons]]'' [[expansion]].
* 5 [[Antique Summoning Stone]] can be gained from completing the [[Canthan Reward Track]] on repeatable as often you want for 5 antique stones every time
